text:
marie: Heads up — partner archival bucket (gs://partner-archives) has ~900 objects encrypted with deprecated KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/deprecated-v1`. Need controlled unwrap/rewrap + compliance audit.
devin: blast radius? archives only or anything live?
marie: archives only (cold), plus a few Vault transit keys using same KMS key for legacy secrets. No prod writes, but partner replay jobs could read.
rana: plan: 1) create temporary SA `kms-rotation-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 2) grant decrypt on deprecated-v1 to that SA only 3) add an IAM deny for encrypt on deprecated-v1 to stop new encrypts 4) run canary rewrap -> verify checksums 5) mass rewrap -> swap metadata pointers 6) revoke decrypt + retire key.
devin: I'll own the rewrap worker. Sketch: iterate manifest, decrypt with deprecated-v1, encrypt with partner-v2, write to archives-rewrapped/ prefix, update metadata. Idempotent with retry/backoff.
ops-bot: ticket SEC-4821 created; tentative maintenance 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC.
auditor: require audit export capture: principalEmail, methodName, resourceName, timestamp, correlationId. Store outputs in gs://redwood-security/audit-backfill/3310001234.json. Also snapshot KMS IAM policy before changes.
marie: manifest uploaded to gs://redwood-security/tmp/partner-archive-manifest-3310001234.csv (cols: object_id,bucket,path,last_read,owner_sa). Shared with @devin @rana.
devin: canary tonight 23:30 UTC, picking low-traffic objects (last_read > 60d). Will post canary logs to gs://redwood-security/logs/rewrap-canary-3310001234.txt.
rana: Vault: create transit key partner-v2, test `vault write transit/rewrap name=legacy-partner ciphertext="<old>"` on test secret. Do not remove decrypt binding until rewrap-runner completes.
auditor: kicked off KMS audit query (job id: audit-3310001234) for 180d window. Expect output in ~30m.
devin: canary result: 25/25 rewrapped OK, checksums verified, consumer read test passed. Uploaded logs.
rana: Vault rewrap test passed on test-secret-09. No regressions.
auditor: audit backfill complete: 12 encrypts, 31 decrypts in 180d. Two decrypts attributed to an outdated partner CI SA — opened follow-up to rotate. Full dump at gs://redwood-security/audit-backfill/3310001234.json
marie: mass rewrap scheduled in maintenance window. Owners: marie (lead & partner comms), devin (tooling & run), rana (IAM/Vault steps), auditor (audit capture).
devin: runbook link: gs://redwood-security/runbooks/partner-rewrap-3310001234.md. Will stream progress here during the window.
marie: rollback criteria: >0.5% checksum failures or any consumer regressions -> stop job, restore metadata pointers, notify partner and SEC-4821-high.
ops-bot: SEC-4821 updated: canary ok, maintenance confirmed.
marie: final note — request temp access via #access-requests with reason 'rewrap-run 3310001234' if you need it.
